Carmen: Putting this up so we have a single thread for the rollout choreography of tenant-priority + regional-fallbacks. Main ask: agree on canary windows, gating queries, and the rollback ladder. My draft: smoke internal 24h -> regional 5% 48h -> regional 25% 24h -> global 100%. Also want a 2% mirrored AB holdback for quality.

Eli: +1. Make the first regional phase 72h if we expect noisy tail latencies. Gate triggers: error_rate > 0.4% OR p95 latency increase > 20% OR sustained queue_len > 80 => pause. Cost cap: token_cost_ratio <= 1.4x.

Zoe: Telemetry panel items: p50/p95/p99 by region, infra_errors/5m, model_ooms, golden_match_rate, token_cost_ratio. Add offline eval criteria: golden_match drop <= 0.7% allowed for pass. Also require no regression in hallucination_score.

Marco: Runbook (short):
1) pause rollout job (`rbctl rollout pause --id 6250012345`)
2) apply per-tenant override (`rbctl flag set --flag tenant.prio --tenant 777 --pct 0`)
3) verify traffic drained in console and model-pool logs
4) notify customers + open incident bridge if VIP impacted
Rollback ladder: per-tenant override -> regional rollback -> global throttle to 50% -> off. Ops owns smoke/alpha, eng-platform owns later phases.

Carmen: Need to freeze unrelated model-facing flags for the duration. Also add snapshot_id to rollout metadata for A/B replay. Example SQL for gating panel:
``sql
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE rollout_id='6250012345') - percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE rollout_id='baseline') FROM requests SINCE 15m
```

deploy-bot: orchestration queued -> tenant-prio/canary -> smoke window 2026-07-08T02:00:00Z :rocket:

Eli: I'll own the automation and correlation IDs. oncall — please confirm staffing for the first 72h.

oncall: acknowledged. Will staff smoke and first regional window.

Carmen: Great. I'll update the PRD, publish the support playbook, and send the shiproom invite after CI green. If no objections we'll start at the scheduled ETA. :thumbsup:
